rows.jp: 崩壊寸前だった放送部の面々を集めて、合宿にまでこぎつけた。
rows.en: I’d pulled the Broadcasting Club back from the brink, rounded everyone up, and even managed to get us to a summer retreat.

ghs.en:
Piece by piece I gathered this Broadcast Club
on the verge of downfall, until I had attained
a Training Camp.

rows.jp: 大変な苦労があった。
rows.en: It had been no small feat.

ghs.en: There were an awful lot of hardship.

rows.jp: 放送部の正式な部員は現在のところ、
rows.en: The Broadcasting Club’s official roster now consisted of—

ghs.en:
The official member roll of the Broadcast Club
is, at this point in time:

rows.jp: 支倉曜子
rows.en: Youko Hasekura.

ghs.en: Hasekura Youko,

rows.jp: 宮澄見里
rows.en: Misato Miyasumi.

ghs.en: Miyasumi Misato,

rows.jp: 黒須太一
rows.en: Taichi Kurosu.

ghs.en: Kurosu Taichi,

rows.jp: 桜庭浩
rows.en: Hiroshi Sakuraba.

ghs.en: Sakuraba Hiroshi,

rows.jp: 島友貴
rows.en: Tomoki Shima.

ghs.en: Shima Tomoki,

rows.jp: 桐原冬子
rows.en: Touko Kirihara.

ghs.en: Kirihara Touko,

rows.jp: 山辺美希
rows.en: Miki Yamanobe.

ghs.en: Yamanobe Miki,

rows.jp: 佐倉霧
rows.en: Kiri Sakura.

ghs.en: Sakura Kiri.

rows.jp: の八人。
rows.en: Eight of us in all.

ghs.en: Eight people total.

rows.jp: この八人……合宿前段階で断絶の関係にあった。
rows.en: Before the retreat, the eight of us were already divided by a web of broken relationships.

ghs.en:
And these eight... had a severance of
relations at a stage prior to the Camp.

rows.jp: まず曜子ちゃんは他人に興味ないので、部活になんて参加しない。
rows.en: Youko had no interest in other people, so she wanted nothing to do with club activities.

ghs.en:
First, Youko-Chan has no interest in other people,
therefore she did not participate to activities.

rows.jp: 桜庭はもともと放浪癖があって、定期的に部活に来るなんてのはありえない。
rows.en: Sakuraba was a born wanderer. Regular club attendance was never going to happen.

ghs.en:
Sakuraba has a vagabondist nature, so there was
no him coming to activities on a regular basis.

rows.jp: 島はみみ先輩といさかいを起こして冷戦中。
rows.en: Tomoki had quarreled with Mimi, and the two were locked in a cold war.

ghs.en:
Shima was in the midst of a cold war with
Mimi-senpai, raised by some quarrel.

rows.jp: 冬子は俺と冷戦中。
rows.en: Touko and I were fighting a cold war of our own.

ghs.en: Touko was in the midst of a cold war with me.

rows.jp: 美希は愛想だけは良かったが、霧につきあって部とは距離を隔てた。
rows.en: Miki was friendly enough, but followed Kiri’s lead and kept her distance from the club.

ghs.en:
Miki was fortunately sociable, at least, but she
was separated from us the distance that is her
Tagging Along with Kiri Club.

rows.jp: 霧は俺のこと嫌っているし。
rows.en: Kiri hated me.

ghs.en: Kiri really hates me.

rows.jp: その俺もなんとなくサボっていたし。
rows.en: And I had more or less stopped showing up myself.

ghs.en:
And I myself, for this or that reason, had
been cutting.

rows.jp: みみ先輩が一人で、様々な処理を片づけていたらしい。
rows.en: Apparently, Mimi had been left to handle everything alone.

ghs.en:
Mimi-senpai seemed to be straightening up all
sorts of various processes, all alone.

rows.jp: 俺は奮起し、皆を集めた。
rows.en: So I got my act together and rounded everyone up.

ghs.en: I roused myself, and gathered everyone.

rows.jp: 多少強引な手段でだ。
rows.en: I may have been a little forceful about it.

ghs.en: With more or less coercive ways.

rows.jp: 去年の海水浴も、似たような手を使った。
rows.en: I’d pulled much the same stunt to get everyone to the beach the year before.

ghs.en:
I used similar ways for last year's beach
outing as well.

rows.jp: 一度引っ張り出せばこっちのものだ。
rows.en: Once I got them out the door, the hard part was over.

ghs.en: If I drag them out once, then they are all mine.

rows.jp: 例年実施されていた夏合宿を敢行に至らしめた。
rows.en: That was how I managed to get the club’s annual summer retreat off the ground.

ghs.en:
And it all led to the daring establishment of the
Mandatory Annual Summer Training Camp.

rows.jp: ……大失敗だった。
rows.en: ...It was a complete disaster.

ghs.en: ...it was a debacle.

rows.jp: 教員に内緒でやったこともあるのだが。
rows.en: We’d also done the whole thing behind the faculty’s back.

ghs.en:
It was something done in secret from the
teaching staff, but...

rows.jp: 『……姉貴のせいだろ！』
rows.en: “...This is all my sister’s fault!”

ghs.en: Tomoki: 『...it's all Aneki's fault!』

rows.jp: 『不愉快です』
rows.en: “How unpleasant.”

ghs.en: Kiri: 『This is unpleasant.』

rows.jp: 『……やめよぅよー、けんかーはー』
rows.en: “...Come ooon. No fiiighting...”

ghs.en: Miki: 『...stooop it, no fightiiing!』

rows.jp: 『ちょ、ちょ、だますとかだまされるとかでなくてさ！』
rows.en: “W-Wait! This isn’t about anyone tricking anyone!”

ghs.en: Taichi: 『but-, but-, this isn't about deceiving nor about being deceived!』

rows.jp: 『騙したんでしょ！』
rows.en: “But you did trick us!”

ghs.en: Touko: 『But you deceived did you!』

rows.jp: 『だから……いやだったんです……みんなでなんて』
rows.en: “This is why... I never wanted... all of us together...”

ghs.en: Misato: 『I told you... it would not be nice... with all of us.』

rows.jp: 揉めた。
rows.en: We fought.

ghs.en: The frictions of dispute.

rows.jp: 何も成し遂げられることはなかった。
rows.en: We accomplished nothing.

ghs.en: There was nothing accomplished.

rows.jp: 人間関係はそのまま。
rows.en: Nothing between us had changed.

ghs.en: These human relationships remained as that.

rows.jp: むしろ、はっきりと浮き彫りにされただけで。
rows.en: If anything, all we’d done was throw every fracture into sharper relief.

ghs.en: Rather, they were made as distinct as in a relief.

rows.jp: 悲嘆と苦痛のうちに合宿は終わってしまった。
rows.en: The retreat ended in grief and pain.

ghs.en:
And then the Training Camp home of sorrow and
agony ended.

rows.jp: 数日間、俺たちは互いに言葉なく過ごした。
rows.en: For the next several days, none of us spoke to one another.

ghs.en:
Several days we passed with reciprocal
words absent.

rows.jp: 単体で会えば、まだ会話もできる。
rows.en: One-on-one, we could still talk.

ghs.en:
Conversation was still possible in single
encounters apart from the rest,

rows.jp: けど複数の疎遠な人間関係が、多重になって、雰囲気は最悪だった。
rows.en: But put several of those estranged relationships in the same room and the atmosphere became unbearable.

ghs.en:
but when multiple, estranged human relationships
overlapped, the atmosphere was terrible.

rows.jp: 今回、みみ先輩の力を借りていた。
rows.en: I had enlisted Mimi’s help this time.

ghs.en: This time, I had borrowed Mimi-senpai's strength.

rows.jp: おかげで先輩の信頼まで、なくしてしまうことになって。
rows.en: And I’d managed to lose her trust in the process.

ghs.en:
Because of this, what I lost went as far as
Senpai's trust.

rows.jp: 先輩は俺をどう思っただろうか。
rows.en: What must she have thought of me?

ghs.en: What does Senpai even think of me?

rows.jp: 七人は帰路に就いた。
rows.en: The seven of us started home.

ghs.en: Seven people reached the way of return.

rows.jp: 俺は見たくなかった。
rows.en: I didn’t want to look.

ghs.en: I did not not want to see them.

rows.jp: 憔悴し、倦怠し、視線を外しあって交わらせず。
rows.en: At everyone haggard and exhausted, averting their eyes, refusing to let them meet.

ghs.en:
This exhaustion, this weariness, this averting
of gazes that are never let cross.

rows.jp: そんな他人のようなみんなの顔を。
rows.en: At faces that made us look like strangers.

ghs.en: Those faces of people strangers to each other.

rows.jp: だから先頭に立った。
rows.en: So I took the lead.

ghs.en: So I moved on ahead.

rows.jp: 早足で、歩いた。
rows.en: I set a brisk pace.

ghs.en: I walked at a quick pace.

rows.jp: 途中で日が暮れた。
rows.en: Night fell along the way.

ghs.en: En route, the day grew darker.

rows.jp: ひどく長い時間、歩いていた気がする。
rows.en: It felt as though we had been walking forever.

ghs.en:
There was this feeling of having walked for
horribly long hours.

rows.jp: 何時間も。
rows.en: For hours.

ghs.en: A countless number of hours.
ghs.assessment: 何時間も means many hours or hours on end. "A countless number of hours" exaggerates the duration into something literally innumerable.

rows.jp: 普段は一時間もかからない道だ。
rows.en: Normally, the walk took less than an hour.

ghs.en:
On a path that ordinarily never takes more
than an hour.

rows.jp: 疲労のせいか。
rows.en: Maybe it was exhaustion.

ghs.en: Was it fatigue?

rows.jp: 誰も何も言わなかった。
rows.en: No one spoke.

ghs.en: No one said even one word.

rows.jp: 七つの足音だけの世界だった。
rows.en: The whole world was nothing but seven sets of footsteps.

ghs.en:
The sound of seven pairs of footsteps was
the entire world.

rows.jp: 異様に静かな山道。
rows.en: The mountain road lay unnaturally still.

ghs.en: An unnaturally quiet mountain trail.

rows.jp: 虫の音さえも耳に届かない。
rows.en: Not even the chirp of an insect reached my ears.

ghs.en: Not even the sound of insects reaches the ears.

rows.jp: 空気までも冷たく感じさせる。
rows.en: The silence made even the air feel cold.

ghs.en: A chilling sensation made by the mood alone,
ghs.assessment: The source says the eerie quiet made even the air feel cold. The English replaces the air with a generic "chilling sensation" produced by mood alone, removing the concrete sensory image.
ghs.remedy: Use "It made even the air feel cold,".

highlights.text: A chilling sensation made by the mood alone,

rows.jp: 夏だというのに。
rows.en: Though it was summer.

ghs.en: when however it is Summer.
ghs.assessment: The source supplies a concessive fragment: despite it being summer. "When however it is Summer" is ungrammatical and uses a temporal connector instead of a clean concessive relation.

rows.jp: その瞬間、
rows.en: At that moment—

ghs.en: That instant,

rows.jp: 世界がぶれたようだった。
rows.en: the world seemed to waver.

ghs.en: the world shook and blurred.

rows.jp: 同じ風景が、違う側面から見たもののように感じられた。
rows.en: The same landscape felt as though I were seeing it from another side.

ghs.en: It was the same scene, but there was the feeling of it being seen from the wrong side.

rows.jp: 一度立ち止まった。
rows.en: I stopped.

ghs.en: I came to a halt once.

rows.jp: 進んでいいものか、どうか。
rows.en: Should I keep going?

ghs.en: Should I advance on, should I not?

rows.jp: けど俺は進んだ。
rows.en: But I kept going.

ghs.en: But I went on.

rows.jp: 「ぺけくーん……」
rows.en: “Pekeee...”

ghs.en: Misato: "Peke-kuuun...!"

rows.jp: 背後から、先輩の声が追いかけてきた。
rows.en: Her voice chased after me from behind.

ghs.en: Senpai's voice began chasing me from the back.

rows.jp: けど俺は進んだ。
rows.en: But I kept going.

ghs.en: But I went on.

rows.jp: 前向きに逃げていた。
rows.en: I was moving forward by running away.

ghs.en: I fled towards what was ahead.

rows.jp: この時もし『見直して』いたら。
rows.en: If I had “taken a second look” then—

ghs.en: If I had Taken a Better Look at that time,

rows.jp: あるいは立ち止まらなかったら。
rows.en: or if I hadn’t stopped at all—

ghs.en: or perhaps if I had never come to a stop,

rows.jp: 俺たちは道をあやまらずに済んだのだろうかと、考えてしまう。
rows.en: I can’t help wondering whether we might have avoided taking the wrong road.

ghs.en: I was thinking about whether we could have ended up on the correct path without making any mistake.
